sourceIssues.title: Where to place progress points
sourceIssues.summary: Reporter described an Intel TBB program: about 50 end-to-end profiling runs suggested a limited improvement; placing a progress point in an already known optimized region changed which source line appeared. No matched before/after artifacts were replayed in this research.

sourceIssues.title: Incorrect predictions if code contains usleep calls
sourceIssues.summary: Reporter supplied a pthread/usleep/barrier example and a Windows11 WSL environment. This research did not reproduce the reported prediction problem or infer it applies generally.
